title: Certificate Bundle Credit on Overdue Renewals of Web Hosting Plans
content:
Pricing desk schedule: SSL/TLS Certificates installed on a hosting plan, overdue renewals.

The overdue renewal amount of a Web Hosting Plans plan is reduced by a certificate bundle credit when one or more Harborline certificate subscriptions (SSL/TLS Certificates) in status active are installed on this plan: USD 12.00 when at least one of them is an OV or EV product, USD 6.00 when all of them are DV products; a plan with no active Harborline certificate installed on it receives no certificate bundle credit.

The OV and EV products are Harborline OV Single Domain, Harborline OV Wildcard, Harborline EV Single Domain and Harborline EV Multi-Domain; the DV products are Harborline DV Single Domain, Harborline DV Multi-Domain and Harborline DV Wildcard.

| Active certificates installed on the plan | Certificate bundle credit |
|---|---|
| at least one OV or EV product, with or without DV products | USD 12.00 |
| one or more, all DV products | USD 6.00 |
| none | none |

**Illustrations.** A plan with an active Harborline DV Wildcard and an active Harborline OV Single Domain installed receives USD 12.00. A plan with two active DV certificates receives USD 6.00. A certificate installed on a different plan, or one not in status active, is not counted for this plan.
